_help.about: [NOT WIRED YET — design §FB] Two hands (Mike, 6 Oct, 22:32): the mouse wheel cycles the right hand, holding Tab and scrolling cycles the left; Q no longer swaps (replaces the crawler's weapon_swap). Every action rebindable on a Controls page in Settings. First guesses by Claude (chat), 6 Oct night; the designer owns them.
_help.right: §FB (Mike): what the right hand holds; the wheel alone cycles it. 'spear' only once found (§ED.7). Scrolling a lit torch away puts it out, as built (Torch.stow).
_help.left: §FB (Mike): left-hand things live in their own small strip of the pack; hold Tab and scroll to cycle them, and to 'empty'.
_help.wheel_drives: §FB (Mike): the wheel drives the right hand by default; the player can switch it to the left in Controls (wheel_drives_options).
_help.tab_hold: §FB first guess: holding Tab shows the left-hand strip, wordless, inside the 480-line frame (§Y); tapping Tab alone does nothing in the crawler for now (no inventory screen there).
_help.clicks: §FB (Mike): left click swings the right hand's thing (§CN), right click interacts. left_with_pot is Claude's first guess (§FI.2 call 12): hold to bring the hands together and light the wick (fire_pots.json), keep holding to aim, release to throw; the torch doesn't swing while a pot is in the left hand.
_help.douse_key: §FC.3 first guess (§FI.2 call 12): smother your own torch and keep holding it. Rebindable.
_help.rebind: §FB (Mike): a Controls page in Settings; every action rebindable, saved per player (Claude Code picks where).
